tour.locked: Sign in to open this one — it reads your own data.
tour.launch_caption: Walks through every feature and where it lives, and tells you what changed in the latest release.
tour.finished: Tour finished — reopen it any time from Profile.
tour.news_intro: Shipped since you were last here.
tour.welcome_body: TopStocks turns your broker statements into your real numbers: returns, risk and tax, in your own currency. This tour shows each feature and takes you to it.
tour.import_body: Drop a statement from Revolut, DEGIRO, Trading 212, IBKR, Saxo or any crypto exchange. You see every row before it is saved, and re-importing never duplicates. No file yet? **Use demo transactions**.
tour.positions_body: Your holdings with live prices, value and weight, and which broker holds each one.
tour.risk_body: **Real return** is what your book actually earned, deposits aside. **Risk** is what you hold today: by sector, country, currency and broker.
tour.projection_body: A range, not a prediction: where your portfolio could be in 1 to 10 years. Add a monthly contribution or a target and see your chance of reaching it.
tour.tax_body: Your realized gains per year and the tax they owe, under your country's rules (12 countries). Set your tax residence in Profile.
tour.income_body: Dividends per year and per holding, including ones your statement missed. **Fees** shows what your broker charged and what the spread cost you.
tour.review_body: Each holding scored on quality and price: what to sell, trim or add to, with the tax each move costs. Type any ticker to judge it the same way. Not advice.
tour.pulse_body: Market mood as a 0–100 **risk appetite** score, what drives it and what it means for your portfolio. The detail tables sit below.
tour.market_body: Any stock, fund or coin: chart, financials, analysts, insiders and news, each figure with its source. **Analyze with AI** hands it to the assistant.
tour.sector_body: Pick a sector and see its best three companies, by quality and by momentum. The calendar shows your earnings, dividends and tax deadlines.
tour.assistant_body: A chat on every page that knows your portfolio; ask by voice too. Free with a daily limit, or unlimited with your own AI key. It remembers what you tell it and asks before changing anything.
tour.journal_body: Every move the app proposed and showed you, with the figures it was made on and what came of it. Read it all in **Profile → Journal**, or one name from the chip on its ticker page.
tour.notify_body: An evening summary and price alerts on Telegram. Link your account once in Profile → Notifications.
tour.investor_body: Your risk tolerance, horizon and focus. The assistant reads it before answering.
tour.prefs_body: Currency, language and tax residence; changes save as you make them. Also here: CSV export, the **Claude** connector and this tour.
tour.daily_body: An AI card on Home every morning: your portfolio against the S&P 500, today's alerts and what is worth a look. Press the **pencil** to choose what it tells you.
tour.news_2026_09_tax_body: Pick your residence in Profile and the tax report applies its rules.
tour.news_2026_09_daily_body: One AI briefing a day on Home, nothing to type.
tour.news_2026_09_fees_body: Commissions and spread per broker, which your statement never itemises.
tour.news_2026_09_demo_body: A sample book to try the app before importing. Your first import removes it.
tour.news_2026_09_pulse_body: Market mood as a 0–100 score, with indices, rates and inflation.
tour.news_2026_09_profile_body: Every setting in one row with its explanation. Export your trades as CSV.
tour.news_2026_09_weekly_body: Every Sunday, one message on how your portfolio is doing against the index.
tour.watchlist_body: The tickers you follow. Add them by searching and sort them into **groups**. Every other page reads this list.
tour.news_2026_09_watchlist_body: Add tickers by searching for them and sort them into **groups**.
tour.news_2026_09_1_voice_body: Press the **mic** and speak your question. The audio is never kept.
tour.news_2026_09_2_splitfix_body: Import spots splits your statement left out and fixes your share count.
tour.news_2026_09_2_transfers_body: Moving shares to another broker no longer counts as a sale or gets taxed.
tour.news_2026_09_2_sectors_body: Pick a sector and see its best three companies.
tour.news_2026_09_4_sector_tech_body: A second sector ranking, by trend, RSI and MACD.
tour.news_2026_09_4_projection_body: The **Projection** tab estimates your book at 1–10 years and your chance of reaching your target.
tour.news_2026_09_3_newapp_body: Every screen rebuilt: same data, no reloads between pages.
tour.news_2026_09_5_daily_more_title: The daily card, line by line
tour.news_2026_09_5_daily_more_body: Each line opens its own **analysis**, with tables and peers.
tour.news_2026_09_6_import_body: Platform, statement, review, confirm, with your portfolio beside it.
tour.news_2026_09_7_whatif_body: Ask the assistant what tax a sale would cost. Nothing is sold.
tour.news_2026_10_memory_body: Say “remember that…” and it keeps it for good. Edit it in **Settings → Memory**.
tour.news_2026_10_routines_body: Ask for something “every morning” and Home's card answers it before you ask.
tour.news_2026_10_claude_body: Connect TopStocks to Claude and ask about your portfolio from there. Set it up in Profile.
tour.news_2026_10_1_fixbook_title: Fix your book from the chat
tour.news_2026_10_1_fixbook_body: Tell the assistant what's wrong and it fixes it once you confirm, with **Undo**.
tour.news_2026_10_2_home_body: Press **Customise** to reorder, hide or add cards.
tour.news_2026_10_2_brief_title: Choose what the daily card tells you
tour.news_2026_10_2_brief_body: Press the **pencil** and write one line per topic: each becomes a section.
tour.news_2026_10_3_crypto_title: A coin read as a coin
tour.news_2026_10_3_crypto_body: All-time high, cycle, derivatives and your holding, on each coin's page.
tour.news_2026_10_4_analysts_body: Consensus, price targets and earnings revisions on each share's page.
tour.news_2026_10_5_review_title: What to sell and what to add to
tour.news_2026_10_5_review_body: A new page that tells you what to sell, trim or add to, with each move's tax.
tour.news_2026_10_6_journal_body: Look back on every move the app proposed, the figures behind it and what came of it.
tour.hello_import_cap: Revolut, Trading 212, DEGIRO, IBKR or CSV
tour.hello_portfolio_cap: P/L, risk and taxes, on their own
tour.hello_ai_cap: About your portfolio or any ticker
tour.hello_hint: No statement? Search any ticker up top.
